grid_charging.seasonality: limited in summer; can fully charge battery on some winter days

interpretation.grid_export: Because battery-to-grid export is disabled, grid export is treated as surplus PV not absorbed by household load or battery charging.
interpretation.battery_discharge: Battery discharge includes both solar-charged and grid-charged energy and must not be treated as solar output without source attribution.
interpretation.model_role: Empirical Northland residential calibration case, not a representative national average. Useful as a lower-yield, imperfect-siting case and as a check on PV+battery self-consumption assumptions.
